pitch_en: Provides integrated solar energy financing and engineering for Latin American businesses, combining innovative financial models with technical project management.
pitch_es: Proporciona financiamiento e ingeniería solar integrada para empresas latinoamericanas, combinando modelos financieros innovadores con gestión técnica de proyectos.
cta_pitch_en: Solar financing and engineering so companies can adopt clean power with flexible capital structures.
cta_pitch_es: Financiamiento e ingeniería solar para que empresas adopten energía limpia con estructuras de capital flexibles.

sections.head_en: Many companies in Latin America face high energy costs and barriers to upfront capital for solar self-generation.
sections.head_es: Muchas empresas en América Latina enfrentan altos costos de energía y barreras de capital inicial para autoconsumo solar.
sections.body_en: Many companies in Latin America face high energy costs and barriers to upfront capital for solar self-generation.

steps.text_en: End-to-end solar project finance, design, installation, and O&M—including PPA and leasing models with no initial investment.
steps.text_es: Financiamiento integral, diseño, instalación y O&M solar—incluyendo modelos PPA y leasing sin inversión inicial.
